case.summary: The evidence is not sufficient to decide on this customer report alert for card C13171-K2, at a fraud probability of 0.55 resting on 1 independent signal(s): the cardholder does not recognise the transaction (arrived as the trigger). The activity fits card not present fraud: a card-not-present transaction on a device the account has used before, or with no device record at all. No other documented pattern fits the evidence. Recommended actions: STEP_UP_AUTH, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, with exposure of $55.68.

The cardholder reported this transaction as unrecognised: Customer C13171 message: 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3558054.
Against this card's own prior history of 899 transactions, $55.68 sits at the 68% percentile (mean $54.02, largest previously $407.32).
2 prior authorisation(s) on this card in the preceding hour and 6 in the preceding 24 hours.
The transaction ran on device profile `? | ? | chrome 66.0 | ?`, reported as Found to this account. That profile appears on 175 card(s) book-wide.
8 prior charges of about $55.68 exist on this card but their spacing is irregular (intervals 1d, 11d, 23d, 16d, 90d, 10d, 0d), so this is a repeated amount rather than a recurring charge
This customer has 19 closed investigation(s) before this alert: 18 confirmed fraud, 1 cleared. Patterns previously found: card_not_present_fraud, card_not_present_new_device.

The closest prior investigations by channel, exposure and recency are CC-5513, CC-5457, CC-5380. The nearest, CC-5513, was a $56.07 online case closed as confirmed_fraud with pattern card_not_present_fraud.

sar.reason: No regulatory filing is required: policy 3a needs confirmed or strongly suspected fraud together with an aggravating condition (exposure over $1,000, a shared origin across accounts, or an undocumented pattern), and this case meets none of them.
